title: PVB repair: check the model, freeze exposure, and retest path
description: PVB repair must account for the exact model, vacuum-breaker configuration, above-ground installation conditions, and freeze exposure.
prompt: What makes PVB repair different from a generic backflow repair?
answer: PVB repair must account for the exact model, vacuum-breaker configuration, above-ground installation conditions, and freeze exposure. A repair is not complete when the device is reassembled; required retesting and filing still govern closure.
urgency: Escalate freezing damage, damaged piping, inaccessible elevation, or uncertainty about the installed PVB model and orientation.
diagramAlt: Backflow service and compliance workflow reference
identifiers: Photograph the bonnet, label, test cocks, shutoffs, and surrounding irrigation piping.
Check for freeze exposure and visible cracks before assuming an internal service kit is sufficient.
Confirm whether the utility requires a certified retest after service.

choices.label: I have a notice or program requirement
choices.detail: Use the issuing program to verify deadline and filing requirements.

choices.label: The assembly failed or needs service
choices.detail: Document the device and define repair plus retest scope.

choices.label: I manage a commercial asset
choices.detail: Separate access, shutdown, testing, and closeout responsibilities.

steps.title: Establish the exact record
steps.body: Capture model, size, orientation, elevation context, and the visible damage or failed result.

steps.title: Define the specific scope
steps.body: Ask whether the body, piping, shutoffs, or supports change the repair scope beyond internal components.

steps.title: Prove the closeout
steps.body: Complete required certified testing and preserve the final record with irrigation asset notes.

safeChecks: Do not operate or service a frozen assembly until qualified assessment.
Keep test access and air openings clear.
Use exact model literature for internal parts.
stopConditions: The body or connected piping is cracked.
The required model or retest route cannot be verified.
notThisDevice: A generic service listing does not establish program eligibility.
A device family is not enough to identify compatible parts.
